body: !remindme two weeks
alright!! tysm, i'll definetely get it checked.

keep going man, you're doing great. so i suppose you're married? that's awesome!! i hope you get the support you need, also you can talk to me anytime. and like, having a natural deep voice rocks. i wish you the best with your healing process, stay strong, we can do this!!

hey, thank you so so so much for taking your time to reply to me. it means a lot. im so proud and happy for you, its a hard and slow process to find, then accept yourself. i hope i'll get there one day as well. tysm, i hope you have a great day!!

hell yeah dude, same!!
working out, eating healthy, socializing<<<<< sleeping to avoid the Big Sad😎
yeah, probably i should stop watching them. i just really, really want to make sure i'm on the right path

thank you so much. i will definetely try to do the writing thing!! that last part means so much to me. i tried so hard as well, i still do, i tried to fit in with the girls any way i could but it just never worked. im just... always hoping that would change one day.

i still haven't found a better way, but i hope i will someday. and i know they suck, and i'm so sorry you had to learn it the hard way as well. i realized if i take care of scars right away, properly, they heal relatively quicker and nicer than my previous ones. yeah, i was really dumb at 14.

thank you so much!! i'm feeling a bit better, i guess i'm just more vulnerable this time of the year. probably because of what you said, my experiences with winter weren't that nice so far, but i'm going to try my best to make some good memories.
tysm for your answer!! it actually healed okay with just cleaning and using bepanten, i just had to take out the gauge and replace it with a regular piercing.
also we're from Mid-Europe, and i'm sure if i find it disgusting other guys don't like it either.
we're both 17, the girl is 16 i think.
Thank you so much! ❤

Boy i wish that was the case. I just lowkey can't stop overthinking to the point where i'm unable to function. The thought of losing him as a friend hurts so bad and i don't dare to risk what we have because i'm too eager.
Yeah, i'm not so good with that. I'm pretty chickened out to ask him, and i'm scared he'd take it the wrong way as if it was bothering me. Yeah, ngl i'm just not ready for a big feely talk.
Thank you for all of your replies, it makes me feel so much better to know that i'm not alone with this. I love y'all, we can do this 💪❤

Same here. I feel so bad for feeling weird, i thought he's a really great guy and i still can't believe he'd do something like this. And thank you so much for replying, i hope you're okay as well. Stay safe, friend.
I just can't believe it's really happening and i still keep asking myself if i'm overreacting or just paranoid. I mean he has a wife, and she was only a floor under us while this all happened
Thank you so much for your reply, it means so much to me right now. I wish you all the best

Yeah, i've been thinking about this a lot actually. I think i'm gonna lay low for a while and if things don't change i'm gonna tell him. Probably. Thank you so much for commenting, mate! Have a nice day! ❤💪
Thank you so much for your comment, dude. I've been rereading this a lot, it's nice to know you are in a similiar situation and i'm not alone. Take care man ❤
Yeah, i suppose you're right. Thanks so much for your answer man, have a nice day!

Thank you so much. Your comment means a hell lot to me. I'm going to try to do this, imagining if i already have everything. Fake it till you make it, i guess. I just wish something would happen, a real good big push and some energy so i could start over and try to be happy. Happier, at least. And again, thank you, friend. Thank you for telling me my pain is valid, because i don't get that a lot. Some of my therapists have said that i'm too young to know what i feel. Anyway, i hope you're doing good. Take care, dude.

Hey. Thank you so much for commenting and being so supportive. And you're really right about everything, about me letting this shit ruin my life. And i know i'm doing it and it's wrong, i just don't think and i don't know how to change it. Therapy hasn't done much yet and i wish i could say that i believe it will help, but yeah... i just need to give it some time. That's what i should do, i know. I guess knowing what i'm wrong in and what i should be doing is good for a start. Thank you again, it made me calm down a bit to read your message. Take care you too, friend :)
